name: table-branch-scope-sync
title: Synchronize table management with selected branch
description: Make the table management page use the shared manager restaurant selection so changing the header branch reloads that branch's floors and tables.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The backend tables query is already restaurant-scoped. TableManagement owns a separate local restaurant state initialized from AuthContext[0], so it ignores the shared ManagerLayout branch selection. Reuse useManagerRestaurantSelection and reset branch-specific UI state on selection changes.
